name: LLM Generate
description: Generates text using the LLM Provider API.

inputs.name: Prompt
inputs.description: The prompt to send to the model

outputs.name: Generated Text
outputs.description: The generated text from the model

args: $body = @{ prompt = '{{prompt}}'; max_new_tokens = 800; temperature = 0.7 } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8000/v1/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'; $response.generated_text
